name: Establish the evidence ledger
work: Freeze the permitted baseline and source hashes. Map HTTP actions, local RPC implementation methods, scheduler registrations and DbSets. Keep missing contracts and per-operation implementations as separate states; this plan provides the initial ledger.
exit: 98 controller files reconcile to 818 static attributes; source integrity gate passes; no unsupported runtime-endpoint or production-completion claim.

name: Finish bounded lawful runnable families
work: Close runtime acceptance on recovered catalog/badge implementations and locally completed NodeInfo/miniapp package candidates. Do not expand candidate-only surface indefinitely while authority/schema/wire facts remain unresolved.
exit: Each claimed operation has a source-backed synthetic fixture, HTTP error/binding checks, actual process smoke, relevant persistence/restart result and a precise production-gap statement.

name: Implement local domain and persistence
work: Parallelize Develop project/product/board rules, Passport notable-day/realm/progression rules, Sphere taxonomy/post/feed selection, Messager message/room transactions and Wallet ledger/order/subscription state machines. Do not wait on auth to write isolated domain/repository tests.
exit: Per-family success/failure/concurrency tests exercise real disposable PostgreSQL; no in-memory substitute is counted as persistence; full exposed shared models remain gated until legally established.

name: Resolve authority and shared contracts
work: Use independently permitted interface evidence or rights-holder-approved specifications for missing claims, permission strings, shared model serialization, enums and wire descriptors. Keep unavailable facts explicit; do not import excluded sources or guess values.
exit: Authenticated and anonymous differential tests, permission denial matrix and interoperable transport fixtures pass without excluded artifacts.

name: Connect events, jobs, storage and providers
work: Wire tested local domains to cache/NATS/websocket/RPC adapters, object-store/media pipelines and controlled provider fixtures. Cover registered jobs and hosted workers, not just HTTP methods.
exit: Integration tests prove replay/idempotency, retry/ack, multi-replica coordination, storage cleanup and crash/restart behavior; no live provider side effect was required.

name: Verify full services and clients
work: Reconcile the action ledger with executable ASP.NET/gateway discovery and complete authorized client scenarios across existing Go identity/gateway/storage/notification services.
exit: Every in-scope operation is matched to an implementation, passing evidence or an explicit agreed omission; route/model/authority/event/storage parity is validated end to end.

name: Rehearse migration and release
work: Build containers and run synthetic data migration/reconciliation, rollback, failure recovery, configuration/health/readiness and load tests before a separately authorized cutover.
exit: Exact published commit has passing required CI, artifact/source manifests and a tested rollback plan. No production-complete claim while any required gate remains pending.
